name: fishing_boat
what: a 20 m stern trawler / longliner, steel, wheelhouse forward, gantry aft, gear in the water when fishing

signature.lights: trawling: green over white all-round, sidelights, sternlight, deck floodlights; masthead when steaming
signature.ir: warm exhaust stack and wheelhouse, a large hull: a big IR target (~6 K over the sea)

ais: class A (EU: fishing vessels >= 15 m must carry it)
behaviour: slow, long dwell on the grounds, gear astern (it cannot manoeuvre freely while trawling)
basis: dimensions, power and speeds typical of 18-24 m North Sea trawlers and longliners; RCS of a steel craft that size (tens to hundreds of m2); AIS per EU Regulation 2002/59 as amended (fishing >= 15 m)
